hud.status-pill.data: seed 1 stone town: the mode's tag, date, population, food, coin

hud.status-pill.sandbox.data: a new sandbox from the title: the mode's tag (the building words), date, population, food, coin, the welcome closed

hud.steward-bubble.data: the steward's line (quiet, or the advisor's line when he speaks)

hud.event-card.lord-moment.data: the lord's suit filed: its Wave 40 picture and the ledger's sentence

hud.event-card.family-moment.data: the first child: the ledger's sentence, the child and the parents named, the way to the chronicle

modal.history.family-links.data: the first child's record in the chronicle (as modal.history.records: the detail scrolls): a biography button for each person its record names

slot.population.panel.data: the population log inside the slot

slot.population.records.data: the famine town's population records after it ran (QA-028: the records, not a 22 px band)

slot.ledger.steward.data: the stone town's stocks with the steward's advice open

hud.steward-bubble.ledger.data: the steward's open advice beside the ledger

slot.ledger.steward-concern.data: the famine's alerts with the steward's warning open

slot.ledger.rights.data: chapter 4's rights register (charter rights, fee farm, revolt pressure)

slot.ledger.rights-decline.data: chapter 2's register after a right is lost

slot.ledger.wage.data: chapter 3's wage ledger under the stocks

modal.year-review.data: 1302's card at 1303's first tick: its decisions (or none), the factions' moves, the town's people and money

hud.event-card.famine-answered.data: chapter 1's famine after the answer: the line, until when, the bottleneck left

modal.history.records.data: the stone town's chronicle: timeline, filters, record list, detail

modal.history.snapshot-figure.data: the then-map with its caption (the caption measured beside the framed box)

modal.history.biography.king.data: the king's biography: the empty-records line

modal.history.factions.data: chapter 4's factions: influence, tug of war, relations

modal.history.factions-panel.data: the nine factions' rows in Wave 14's faction panel, the kind icons beside four names

modal.lord.home-petition.data: the boundary dispute (Wave 44 01) in the DEC-CARD layout: the situation, the stake, each answer now / later / who remembers

modal.lord.home-petition.guardian.data: a minor lord's wardship petition (the court line with his guardian)

modal.lord.request.data: the town's request (a proclamation waiting) in the DEC-CARD layout: the grant's now (the works it opens) and later (the actual's day)

modal.lord.registry.data: the first v4 offer the registry drew in the lord's slice (DEC-CARD layout): its why, each answer's tradeoff, now / later / who remembers, the shut one with why

modal.lord.registry-hold.data: the first v4 offer with a hold the lord can choose (DEC-CARD layout): the hold's cost as the engine's run shows it (the claim weakened)

lord.receipt.data: a town-built farmstead's receipt: five reasons, the next best site, the chance, the 10d subsidy and its decisions

lord.receipt-old.data: the same receipt from a save before the chance was kept

lord.receipt-none.data: the opening well: no receipt, the reason instead of an empty frame

lord.receipt-inspector.data: the first store's receipt (or why it has none) from the left inspector

slot.ledger.lord.data: the lord tab: the four policies (stability), the 10d farmstead subsidy, the draft and the dues at 80%

slot.ledger.lord-refusal.data: a subsidy draft past a quarter of the treasury: the reason written, the set button shut

hud.status-pill.lord.data: the lord's slice: date, population, food, coin and the way back to town

slot.ledger.stock-lord.data: the lord's slice stock tab: the treasury by estate under the treasury line, then the stocks

lord.screen.data: the lord screen host over the town: the left menu (each shut item with its reason) and the screen (empty until an area opens one)

slot.ledger.lord-open.data: the ledger's lord tab with the way into the lord screens above the policies

lord.negotiation.draft.data: the marriage offer before any is sent: the grooms, the clause editor, the draft treaty (consent alone), the counterpart's tier and reasons, the refusal (no terms) under a shut offer button

lord.negotiation.counter.data: the counterpart's counter waiting a season: the clauses with the one it added marked, its tier and reasons, the deadline and what silence means, each answer's now / later / who remembers (DEC-CARD), accept and refuse as equal choices

lord.negotiation.treaty.data: the drawn treaty sheet on the counter's page: its clause rows within it

lord.negotiation.row.data: one drawn clause row of the treaty: its words within the row

lord.negotiation.reason.data: one drawn reason of the counterpart's tier: its words within it

lord.negotiation.will-change.data: the marriage's progress with the will change due: the events as they fell, the deferred debt, the engine's deadline as a season and the decide button to the will's card (SUIT-THREAD: where the will's chip opens), the contract's clauses under a stamped seal

lord.negotiation.contested.data: the estate contested after the will stood: the rival named, the outcome, the way to its suit on the ledger screen

lord.ledger.promises.data: the promise ledger with kept, broken and open debt instalments (the lord keeps them from the treasury), the lord's open claim

lord.ledger.book.data: the promise book's drawn page inside the ledger: the promises' lines within it

lord.ledger.track.data: the suit's drawn stage track inside the ledger: the stages within it

lord.ledger.empty.data: no promise yet (the marriage only offered): the empty ledger's lines, no timed terms, the lord's claim with its filing button (PLAY-2: its cost, the hearing's sides)

lord.ledger.suit.data: the contested inheritance's suit just filed: the stage track, the hearing's two sides, the five evidence kinds to bring; two claims to file

lord.ledger.neighbour.data: the lord's two closed suits (judged, enforced) and a neighbour's recovery suit against him just filed, with his defence (SUIT-THREAD: evidence, the concord's two terms, the hold shut with its stage)

lord.ledger.defence-enforcing.data: a house's suit against the lord judged for it, its enforcement under way: the lord's hold with its cost, the concord at the whole price

lord.ledger.entry-threat.data: a forcible entry forewarned by a house past −60 (1344): the guard and the gift at the engine's costs, the engine's sentence

lord.ledger.entry-forced.data: the house came in by force: the lord's novel claim (a suit for the possession taken by force) with its filing cost and hearing, the entry in the engine's words

lord.estates.home.data: the estates screen on the home estate: the totals, the attention, the four estates to choose, the home card with its pieces and grants, the exceptions, the petitions

lord.estates.card.data: the home estate's card in its record frame: its pieces and grants within the frame

lord.estates.delegated.data: the inherited estate given to the greedy steward: its card with the overlay, the steward and the two other candidates, the audit by visit, its first season

lord.estates.overloaded.data: the same estate taken direct while a visit's year lowers the attention: load 2 over capacity 1, the warning, the receiver, three seasons

lord.estates.audit-pending.data: a visit's audit waiting for the lord's answer: what it found and the days left (the answer is the decision card's)

slot.ledger.lord-policy-subsidy.data: the ledger's lord tab with a subsidy on offer: the four policies with their icons, the subsidy's notice and its row

lord.region.data: the region map on the inherited state: the home direct, the inherited estate delegated to its steward (chosen, its line under the map), two neighbours; the map fitted

lord.region.zoomed.data: the region map at full zoom on the neighbour-suit state: the first neighbour chosen (its flag a neighbour's, the pieces the lord won of it listed), the map scrolled to it

hud.event-card.will-kept.data: the father's new will as its chip's card: the engine's deadline as a season, the button to the lord screen's marriage page

modal.lord.will-change.data: the father's new will: favour (shut when the treasury is short), support promised (its promise, stake and witnesses), let it stand (the rival's claim) — the engine's run

hud.event-card.suit-defence.data: a neighbour house's suit against the lord: its filing, its stage and next season, the button to the suit in the ledger

hud.event-card.entry-threat.data: a house's forcible entry forewarned: the engine's warning, the season it comes, the button to the warning in the ledger

hud.event-card.audit-kept.data: an audit's finding as its chip's card: what it found, the engine's deadline as a season, the button to the card

hud.event-card.offmap-kept.data: an off-map estate's petition as its chip's card: the ask, the engine's deadline as a season, why it came to the lord, the button to the card

modal.lord.contested.data: the contested inheritance: the rival's hold, both claims' strength, the lord's suit stage, the way to the suit

modal.lord.audit.data: a Michaelmas audit's finding: punish, replace, tolerate — what each recovers, who follows, who remembers

modal.lord.offmap-petition.data: an off-map estate's petition: why it came to the lord, both answers' treasury and the estate's goodwill

lord.standing.data: the standing policies: the manor's twelve petitions (with the all-to-the-lord switch, rules.recurring), the off-map estates' six, the senders' five, each with its setting

lord.standing.kind.data: the heriot opened: the four settings (all secondary, the one in force pressed) and what each would do, this year's count

modal.season-ledger.steward.data: a lord-mode season close with the steward's section: what he handled by which policy (each a drill-in), the money and factions, what he brought

hud.status-pill.market.data: the market town's pill a season after the proclamation: date, population, food, coin, the way back to town

hud.status-pill.market-years.data: the pill four years on: the slice ended, the treasury nearly doubled

lord.screen.market.data: the lord screen host over the market town: the menu and the first open page

lord.estates.market.data: the estates screen four years after the proclamation: the totals, the attention, the estates held, the home card

lord.ledger.market.data: the ledger four years after the proclamation: the promises, four closed suits and a house's suit against the lord at its evidence stage, his defence

hud.event-card.suit-defence.market.data: four years after the proclamation, a house's suit against the lord as its chip's card: its filing, its stage and next season, the button to the ledger

hud.event-card.lord-moment.market.data: four years after the proclamation, the lord's latest moment as its chip's card: the ledger's sentence

hud.event-card.famine.market.data: a season after the proclamation, the great famine's chip (1315–17, the bot's answer given) as its card: its line, until when

lord.negotiation.market.data: the marriage page four years after the proclamation

lord.region.market.data: the region map four years after the proclamation: the estates held and the neighbours

lord.standing.market.data: the standing policies of the market town: each kind with its setting

slot.ledger.lord.market.data: the ledger's lord tab in the market town: the way into the lord screens, the policies

slot.ledger.stock-lord.market.data: the market town's stock tab: the treasury by estate, then the stocks

modal.season-ledger.market.data: the market town's first season close after the proclamation (1317's autumn; lord mode: the steward's section)

slot.population.growth.market.data: four years after the proclamation, a stop held: what holds the town's growth — the cause, since when (unknown after a load), the lord's lever

slot.population.growth-next.market.data: four years after the proclamation, no stop seen yet: what holds the town's next step, headed so, no since (LS1-6, A4)

hud.event-card.growth.market.data: the market town, a stop held: the chip when the stop is first said — its cause, since when, the lever, the way to the panel

hud.event-card.family-born.data: a child of the lord's house born: its name, the ledger's sentence, its parents, the way to the chronicle

hud.event-card.family-died.data: a death in the lord's family: the ledger's sentence, the spouse left, the way to the chronicle

hud.event-card.family-married.data: a marriage in the lord's family: the two by name, the ledger's sentence, the way to the chronicle

hud.event-card.trace.data: the season's news of the lord's decision (the suit filed on the first tick): its year and subject, the neighbour's mind, the way to the chronicle

modal.history.thread-decision.data: the suit filed in 1300, opened from its later chip: what followed (its turns) and who remembers it

modal.history.thread-because.data: a suit's turn: the decision it followed from (the year and who decided), its link back

modal.year-review.lord.data: 1300's card on the engine's yearReview after a load (unseen): the lord's decisions, the steward's, what followed by decision, the town

modal.history.year.data: 1300's year card to the chronicle: the records of 1300 only (both year selects on it)

modal.lord.home-petition.variant-041.data: the pannage petition on the woodland in autumn in 041's words (the longest variant body)

modal.lord.home-petition.variant-048.data: the common-pasture petition in 048's words (the commons against the second merchant house)

modal.lord.home-petition.variant-056.data: the road and bridge petition beside the market in 056's words

modal.lord.registry.variant-067.data: 031's steward offer in 067's words (ability against loyalty; the longest variant title)

modal.lord.registry.variant-078.data: 019's oversight offer in 078's words (the merchant's man against the peasants')

hud.event-card.home-petition-variant.data: the pannage petition's chip card in 041's words, its card put off

hud.event-card.registry-variant.data: 031's offer's chip card in 067's words, its card put off

modal.receipt.home-grant.data: the boundary dispute granted: both factions' relations, each move and from what to what

modal.receipt.home-refuse.data: the chancel's repair refused: the bishop's relation, its move and from what to what

modal.receipt.audit-punish.data: an audit's finding punished: the sum recovered to the treasury, the bishop's relation, the tenants' goodwill, the new steward

modal.receipt.audit-tolerate.data: an audit's finding tolerated: the steward's loyalty, its move and from what to what

modal.receipt.offmap-grant.data: an off-map estate's petition granted: the treasury and the tenants' goodwill

modal.receipt.offmap-refuse.data: an off-map estate's petition refused: the tenants' goodwill

modal.receipt.registry-evidence.data: a registry offer's court roll paid for: the treasury, the evidence and its weight, the suit's costs; then what it set going

modal.receipt.registry-hold.data: the same offer put off (its hold): the claim's strength, its move and from what to what

modal.receipt.registry-marriage.data: a registry offer that sends a marriage offer: the offer and the counterpart's answer at once

modal.receipt.request.data: the town's request granted (the proclamation): the town's era and the works it opens

modal.receipt.famine-relief.data: the famine answered with relief: the bishop's and the commons' relations; then what it does each season

modal.receipt.famine-laissez.data: the famine left to the market: both relations' fall; then the households that leave each season

modal.receipt.petition-charter.data: chapter 1's market charter granted: the merchants' relation and gauge, the right and its stall fee

modal.receipt.petition-wool.data: the Crown's wool refused: the purveyor's take from the treasury, the Crown's relation and its favour lost

modal.receipt.petition-autonomy.data: the borough's autonomy sealed (the longest receipt): the fine, four relations, the rights, the fee farm, the mayor, the scores

modal.receipt.petition-heir.data: the heir named through the daughter: the relief, who heads the family, who came and who left, the family's score

modal.slice-end.data: the slice's end in 1317 (seed 3, five years after the second estate of 1312; ~/fls-slice-end-states rebuilt on the TRACE-KEEP engine): the last year 1316 at the top with its two cards as links, why and when, then and now with the maps, the decisions ranked by what followed, who remembers, a line a year with its big decisions from the thread (1300-1308 too) and what followed each, and its small matters counted in one line

modal.slice-end.record.data: the end page's first decision (1300's market dues, 67 rows followed) opened in the chronicle on its record (closing it comes back to the page)

modal.slice-end.year-card.data: 1316's year card (the last year; the slice ends in 1317 spring by its second estate) opened from the end page's link (the engine's yearReview)

modal.slice-end.season-card.data: 1316 winter's season card (the last closed before the end in 1317 spring) opened from the end page's link (it does not open by itself at the end)
